clause: Prototype/motion model API + steerability + aggregate GUI/Argus/UserManual/HBR closure + export touchpoint [STU-PRO-043,STU-PRO-043a,STU-PRO-043b,STU-PRO-043c,STU-PRO-044,STU-PRO-044a,STU-PRO-044b,STU-PRO-045]

scope.summary: Close out 14.11: (1) ensure every prototyping/motion command (flows, triggers, actions, animations, overlays, scroll, device/presentation, timeline, interactive-document objects) is model-visible and typed-steerable through the Studio command surface (MT-007) with typed I/O, dry_run, receipts, and undo semantics; (2) aggregate GUI/Argus/UserManual closure asserting every panel/control/visible state is headlessly inspectable, steerable, and screenshot-capturable through Argus with no focus steal and ships dual-audience UserManual entries kept same-change current; and (3) the interactive/animated EXPORT touchpoint that enumerates targets and their option surfaces WITHOUT duplicating the export engine: all interactive/motion output is produced through 14.13 StudioExportRecipe (MT-441) - interactive PDF (general/compression/advanced/security options), reflowable + fixed-layout EPUB (version/cover/nav-TOC/content-order/split/image-conversion/CSS+JS/metadata, carrying buttons/MSO/animations/media), HTML (content order/image conversion/CSS; shared article threads across EPUB/HTML/tagged-PDF), animated frames from StudioMotionTimeline + prototype transitions as MP4/WebM/GIF/animated-SVG (size/frame-rate/quality/loop), Lottie optional-only (its absence never blocks authoring or other formats), and an optional read-only motion-inspection adapter exposing timing/easing/keyframes as CSS/JSON/framework code via 14.14.
acceptance_criteria: entire 14.11 model-steerable + Argus/manual-complete; interactive/animated export defers to 14.13 StudioExportRecipe; Lottie optional; no exporter fork
proof_targets: model-API typed-I/O + Argus coverage + manual self-consistency + export-via-14.13 test
expected_tests: live: every prototyping/motion command exposes typed I/O + dry_run + receipt + undo through the Studio command surface
HBR-MAN-003 self-consistency: every prototype/motion command_id has a dual-audience manual entry; Argus target registry covers all studio.prototype.* surfaces with no focus steal

test: interactive/animated export routes through 14.13 StudioExportRecipe (MT-441) for PDF/EPUB/HTML + MP4/WebM/GIF/SVG; Lottie-absent does not block authoring or other formats; no exporter duplicated here

target_entries: Studio / Prototyping & Motion / (section coverage index + export targets)

risk_if_missed: Prototype/motion surface not fully model-steerable/Argus-covered/manual-complete, or export forks a second exporter; closure unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
